evidence.notes: Local SaveResult/DeleteResult/UpsertResult/MergeResult/UndeleteResult/EmptyRecycleBinResult/LockResult/UnlockResult expose id, success, errors, created, merged IDs, updated-related IDs, status-code, message, fields, and empty extended-error-detail accessors where applicable.
Database SaveResult success accessor is asserted on insert and update results.
Database SaveResult id accessor is asserted on successful and failed insert results.
Database SaveResult errors accessor is asserted on successful and failed insert/update results.
Database UpsertResult success accessor is asserted on create and update paths.
Database UpsertResult id accessor is asserted across external-ID create and update paths.
Database UpsertResult created accessor is asserted for external-ID create and update paths.
Database MergeResult success accessor is asserted on a local Account merge.
Database MergeResult id accessor is asserted on the merge master record.
Database MergeResult merged-record IDs accessor is asserted on the duplicate record.
Database MergeResult updated-related IDs accessor is asserted on reparented child records.
Database DeleteResult success accessor is asserted on local delete results.
Database DeleteResult id accessor is asserted on local delete results.
Database DeleteResult errors accessor is asserted on local delete results.
Database UndeleteResult success accessor is asserted on failed and successful undelete results.
Database UndeleteResult errors accessor is asserted on active-record undelete failures.
Database EmptyRecycleBinResult success accessor is asserted on permanent delete results.
Single-record emptyRecycleBin permanently removes a deleted local record.
Database Error status-code accessor is asserted on required-field and unknown-field failures.
Database Error message accessor is asserted on required-field failures.
Database Error fields accessor is asserted on required-field and unknown-field failures.
Database Error extended-error-details accessor is asserted as empty for local modeled DML errors.
Local lock/unlock/emptyRecycleBin allOrNone failures throw DmlException and roll back earlier successful rows in the same call.
List emptyRecycleBin with allOrNone=true rolls back earlier permanent deletes on local failures.

source.content: @isTest private class DatabaseResultAccessorParityTest { @isTest static void resultAccessorsCoverLocalDmlFamilies() { Account base = new Account(Name = 'Base'); Database.SaveResult inserted = Database.insert(base, false); System.assert(inserted.isSuccess()); System.assertNotEquals(null, inserted.getId()); System.assertEquals(0, inserted.getErrors().size()); Database.SaveResult badInsert = Database.insert(new Account(), false); System.assert(!badInsert.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(null, badInsert.getId()); Object badInsertError = badInsert.getErrors().get(0); System.assertEquals('REQUIRED_FIELD_MISSING', badInsertError.getStatusCode()); System.assert(badInsertError.getMessage().contains('Required fields')); System.assertEquals('Name', badInsertError.getFields().get(0)); System.assertEquals(0, badInsertError.getExtendedErrorDetails().size()); Database.SaveResult updated = Database.update(new Account(Id = inserted.getId(), Name = 'Changed'), false); System.assert(updated.isSuccess()); Account unknownWrite = new Account(Id = inserted.getId()); unknownWrite.put('Bogus__c', 'nope'); Database.SaveResult badUpdate = Database.update(unknownWrite, false); System.assert(!badUpdate.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('Bogus__c', badUpdate.getErrors().get(0).getFields().get(0)); Account upsertNew = new Account(Name = 'Upsert New', External_Key__c = 'ext-1'); Database.UpsertResult upsertCreated = Database.upsert(upsertNew, Account.External_Key__c, false); System.assert(upsertCreated.isSuccess()); System.assert(upsertCreated.isCreated()); Account upsertExisting = new Account(External_Key__c = 'EXT-1', Name = 'Upsert Changed'); Database.UpsertResult upsertUpdated = Database.upsert(upsertExisting, Account.External_Key__c, false); System.assert(upsertUpdated.isSuccess()); System.assert(!upsertUpdated.isCreated()); System.assertEquals(upsertCreated.getId(), upsertUpdated.getId()); Account master = new Account(Name = 'Master'); insert master; Account duplicate = new Account(Name = 'Duplicate'); insert duplicate; Contact child = new Contact(LastName = 'Child', AccountId = duplicate.Id); insert child; Database.MergeResult merged = Database.merge(master, duplicate, false); System.assert(merged.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(master.Id, merged.getId()); System.assertEquals(duplicate.Id, merged.getMergedRecordIds().get(0)); System.assertEquals(child.Id, merged.getUpdatedRelatedIds().get(0)); Database.UndeleteResult activeUndelete = Database.undelete(base, false); System.assert(!activeUndelete.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals('ENTITY_IS_NOT_DELETED', activeUndelete.getErrors().get(0).getStatusCode()); Account recycle = new Account(Name = 'Recycle'); insert recycle; Database.DeleteResult deleted = Database.delete(recycle, false); System.assert(deleted.isSuccess()); Database.UndeleteResult restored = Database.undelete(recycle, false); System.assert(restored.isSuccess()); Database.delete(recycle, false); Database.EmptyRecycleBinResult emptied = Database.emptyRecycleBin(recycle, false); System.assert(emptied.isSuccess()); System.assertEquals(0, [SELECT Id FROM Account WHERE Id = :recycle.Id ALL ROWS].size()); Account lockRow = new Account(Name = 'Lock'); insert lockRow; Database.LockResult locked = Database.lock(lockRow, false); System.assert(locked.isSuccess()); Database.UnlockResult unlocked = Database.unlock(lockRow, false); System.assert(unlocked.isSuccess()); } @isTest static void recordActionAllOrNoneRollsBack() { Account lockRollback = new Account(Name = 'Lock Rollback'); insert lockRollback; Account missing = new Account(Id = '001999999999999'); Boolean lockCaught = false; try { Database.lock(new List<Account>{lockRollback, missing}, true); } catch (DmlException e) { lockCaught = true; System.assert(e.getMessage().contains('Database.lock failed')); } System.assert(lockCaught); Account unlockRollback = new Account(Name = 'Unlock Rollback'); insert unlockRollback; Database.lock(unlockRollback, false); Boolean unlockCaught = false; try { Database.unlock(new List<Account>{unlockRollback, missing}, true); } catch (DmlException e) { unlockCaught = true; System.assert(e.getMessage().contains('Database.unlock failed')); } System.assert(unlockCaught); Account recycleRollback = new Account(Name = 'Recycle Rollback'); insert recycleRollback; delete recycleRollback; Boolean emptyCaught = false; try { Database.emptyRecycleBin(new List<Account>{recycleRollback, missing}, true); } catch (DmlException e) { emptyCaught = true; System.assert(e.getMessage().contains('Database.emptyRecycleBin failed')); } System.assert(emptyCaught); List<Account> recycleRows = [SELECT Id, IsDeleted FROM Account WHERE Id = :recycleRollback.Id ALL ROWS]; System.assertEquals(1, recycleRows.size()); Account recycleRow = recycleRows.get(0); System.assert(recycleRow.IsDeleted); } }
